sinopsis.es: Retrato de Jake Williams, que vive solo entre kilómetros de bosque en Aberdeenshire, Escocia. Siempre tiene muchas tareas, aprovecha todo, toca la mandolina, hace compost hace años y se mantiene con lo que cultiva. Tiene otra percepción del tiempo. Para él no se trata de nostalgia por un pasado preeléctrico, sino de un futuro muy real.
sinopsis.en: A portrait of Jake Williams, who lives alone within miles of forest in Aberdeenshire, Scotland. He always has many jobs on, finds a use for everything, plays the mandolin, has made compost for years, and sustains himself from what he grows. His sense of time is different. For him it isn't nostalgia for a pre-electric past, but a very real future.
